def transform(grid):
    # Identify background color (most frequent)
    flat_grid = [cell for row in grid for cell in row]
    bg_count = {}
    for cell in flat_grid:
        bg_count[cell] = bg_count.get(cell, 0) + 1
    bg = max(bg_count, key=bg_count.get)
    
    # Identify frame color (most frequent non-background)
    frame_candidates = [cell for cell in flat_grid if cell != bg]
    if not frame_candidates:
        return [[bg]]
    frame_count = {}
    for cell in frame_candidates:
        frame_count[cell] = frame_count.get(cell, 0) + 1
    frame = max(frame_count, key=frame_count.get)
    
    # Find horizontal and vertical lines
    horizontal_lines = [r for r in range(len(grid)) if any(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(len(grid[0])))]
    vertical_lines = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == frame for r in range(len(grid)))]
    
    # Get all intersection colors
    intersections = [grid[h][v] for h in horizontal_lines for v in vertical_lines]
    special_colors = list(set(intersections))
    
    # If all intersections have the same non-frame color
    if len(special_colors) == 1 and special_colors[0] != frame:
        return [[special_colors[0], special_colors[0], special_colors[0]]]
    else:
        # Create grid of size (H-1)x(V-1)
        out_rows = len(horizontal_lines) - 1
        out_cols = len(vertical_lines) - 1
        if out_rows <= 0 or out_cols <= 0:
            return [[bg]]
        out_grid = [[None for _ in range(out_cols)] for _ in range(out_rows)]
        for i in range(len(horizontal_lines)-1):
            for j in range(len(vertical_lines)-1):
                out_grid[i][j] = grid[horizontal_lines[i]][vertical_lines[j]]
        return out_grid
